name: rosetta-narcissistic-decimal-number
code:
use default

power(value: int, exponent: int) -> int =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        1
    else
        value * power(value, exponent - 1)
    fi

digit_powers(number: int, width: int) -> int =>
    if number == 0 then
        0
    else
        power(number % 10, width) + digit_powers(number / 10, width)
    fi

digit_count(number: int) -> int =>
    if number < 10 then
        1
    else
        1 + digit_count(number / 10)
    fi

is_narcissistic(number: int) -> bool =>
    digit_powers(number, digit_count(number)) == number

let narcissistic = stream(0, number => number || number + 1)
    |> filter(is_narcissistic)
    |> take(25)
    |> map(number => "{number}")
    |> join(" ")

write_line(narcissistic)

use default

power(value: int, exponent: int) -> int =>
    if exponent == 0 then
        1
    else
        value * power(value, exponent - 1)
    fi

digit_powers(number: int, width: int) -> int =>
    if number == 0 then
        0
    else
        power(number % 10, width) + digit_powers(number / 10, width)
    fi

digit_count(number: int) -> int =>
    if number < 10 then
        1
    else
        1 + digit_count(number / 10)
    fi

is_narcissistic(number: int) -> bool =>
    digit_powers(number, digit_count(number)) == number

let narcissistic = stream(0, number => number || number + 1)
    |> filter(is_narcissistic)
    |> take(25)
    |> map(number => "{number}")
    |> join(" ")

write_line(narcissistic)
